download_file_from_url: download a file from a URL to a destination path with optional SSL verification
copy_file_using_gfile: copy a file from a local or remote filesystem path using the tf.io.gfile API
extract_filename_from_response: extract the filename from an HTTP response's content-disposition header
download_with_checksum_verification: download files with async concurrent execution and SHA-256 checksum verification
track_download_progress: track download progress with tqdm progress bars for URL count and file size
